title: Staff Analytics Engineer
description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on our Mission

Zocdoc is seeking a Staff Analytics Engineer to join a centralized team responsible for defining, creating, and maintaining a scalable and robust analytics layer that powers Zocdoc’s strategic analytics, operations, and reporting capabilities. As a Staff-level member, you'll lead the design and implementation of complex data transformations and production-grade data models, establishing standardized datasets that drive critical decision-making across the organization. Collaborating closely with Product Management, Product Engineering, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams, you'll ensure data solutions are strategically aligned, efficient, and consistently reliable, enabling teams across Zocdoc to rapidly gain meaningful insights from high-quality data.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…


Excited about designing and building strategic data products that drive impactful outcomes across the entire organization
Passionate about solving complex, high-impact problems using data and analytics at scale
Committed to setting a high bar for technical excellence and continuously improving whatever you're working on
A collaborative leader who enjoys working cross-functionally in a supportive and highly cooperative environment
Enthusiastic about architecting scalable data solutions using cutting-edge technologies to support long-term business strategies


Your day to day is…


Defining and enabling trusted, strategic datasets and analytics solutions that empower data consumers to quickly and reliably gain insights at scale
Leading efforts to enhance self-serve analytics across the organization through advanced administration, adoption strategies, and training for analytics tools (Looker and Amplitude)
Partnering strategically with analysts, product managers, and product engineers to ensure the analytics infrastructure meets evolving business requirements and is robust and maintainable
Architecting and developing production-grade data transformations and models using SQL, DBT, and Dagster, ensuring optimal performance, maintainability, scalability, and reliability
Collaborating closely with data engineering on strategic infrastructure initiatives to enhance data ingestion, processing pipelines, and integration of new data sources
Driving the establishment and continuous improvement of standards around data governance, security, privacy, quality, and retention, influencing best practices across the organization


You’ll be successful in this role if you have…


6+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar role
3+ years of experience using DBT & DBT Core, with a strong understanding of data modeling and data warehousing concepts
Expertise in writing performant SQL, especially within cloud-based data warehouses like Snowflake, and have strong Looker developer skills, with an emphasis on LookML modeling and overall project design
Experience managing the administration and/or adoption of data visualization tools (e.g. Looker) and event-based analytics/user journey tools (e.g. Amplitude)
Ability to navigate ambiguity and work with urgency in a fast-moving environment with multiple stakeholders
Good communication skills across all levels of stakeholders (business & technical) with the ability to influence and build consensus
Proficiency with Python
Experience with Dagster or other orchestration tools
Experience utilizing AI Codegen to improve the efficiency of your workflow
Experience with data governance principles, KPI management, and supporting data operations for business intelligence


Benefits


Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location
Unlimited Vacation
100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
Commuter Benefits
401(k) with employer funded match
Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
Cell phone reimbursement
Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks
Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
Great Place to Work Certified


Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

NYC Base Salary Range

$180,000—$250,000 USD

About Us

Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. title: Manager, BI + Analytics Engineer
description:
Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, Peregrine helps public safety organizations, state and local and governments, federal agencies, and private-sector institutions address society’s challenges with unprecedented speed and accuracy. Our AI-enabled platform turns siloed and disconnected data into operational intelligence — instantly surfacing mission-critical information to empower better, faster decisions that improve outcomes at every touchpoint. Today Peregrine supports hundreds of customers across 30+ states and two countries, serving more than 125 million people — and we’re amplifying our impact as we expand into the enterprise and internationally.

The Role

As Peregrine’s Manager, BI + Analytics Engineer, you’ll play a foundational role in shaping how data is modeled, accessed, and used across the company. You will own the architecture and execution of our internal analytics stack, partnering closely with stakeholders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to turn raw data into insight and insight into action.

This is a highly cross-functional and high-visibility role — you’ll work directly with leaders across the business to define KPIs, automate workflows, and level up our data infrastructure. If you're a hands-on builder who thrives in ambiguity, loves translating business questions into clean data pipelines, and wants to shape the future of data at a mission-driven company, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do


Own and scale our data warehouse to support a fast-growing Go-To-Market and product ecosystem
Build and maintain ETL pipelines using dbt to integrate data from tools, apps, and third-party platforms
Design clean, reusable data models that power reporting across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance
Create dashboards and analysis that uncover trends in revenue, product usage, and customer behavior
Set up data quality checks and alerts to ensure accurate, timely, and trustworthy data
Support planning and forecasting by partnering with teams to define KPIs and build forward-looking models


What We Look For


4+ years of experience as a BI Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Engineer in a fast-growing tech environment
Strong command of SQL and data modeling best practices
Proficiency in dbt, modern data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery), and orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect)
Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Hex, Mode, Sigma, or similar
Strong product and business sense — you know how to balance technical purity with speed, scalability, and impact
Comfort working autonomously and owning projects end-to-end
Excellent communication skills with an ability to translate complex concepts to non-technical audiences
Located in New York, NY and willing to work in office four days a week


Annual Salary + Benefits + Equity (if applicable) + Bonus (if applicable)

$150,000—$180,000 USD

title: Senior Data Analytics Developer, Power BI and AWS
description:
Location: Newark, New Jersey

Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Hybrid; three days per week in office




About Us

CARIAN is a purpose-driven, woman-owned consulting and advisory firm dedicated exclusively to the power sector. We partner with leading electric and gas utilities to provide strategic advisory and disciplined execution across program management, business intelligence, and field execution oversight. Guided by integrity, trust, excellence, and accountability, our team helps deliver complex capital programs and build the resilient energy infrastructure that communities depend on.




Position Overview

CARIAN is seeking a Senior Data Analytics Developer, Power BI and AWS to join our team and deliver customer analytics, dashboarding, data engineering, and AI/ML-enabled insights for a major utility program in Newark, New Jersey.

This role will help transform raw operational, customer, and business data into actionable insights, dashboards, data products, and analytics solutions that support strategic decision-making and improve customer experience. The position will work closely with CARIAN leadership, client stakeholders, Customer Analytics, IT, and vendor teams to build Power BI dashboards, optimize data sources and pipelines, support analytics solution design, and incorporate data science, AI, and machine learning approaches where appropriate.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Power BI, AWS cloud services, SQL, Python, data modeling, data visualization, data engineering, and analytics delivery. Experience with customer analytics, call center operations, customer behavior analysis, or customer journey improvement is strongly preferred.

Collect, summarize, analyze, and deliver insights using data from multiple sources.
Develop data models and analytics solutions to support Power BI dashboards and reporting needs.
Design, develop, maintain, and enhance interactive Power BI dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
Identify valuable data sources and support optimization of data pipelines to improve data quality, integrity, security, and usability.
Partner with business stakeholders, Customer Analytics, IT, and vendor teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into analytics solutions.
Facilitate business requirements sessions between business stakeholders, IT, and vendors.
Facilitate and execute testing activities between business stakeholders, IT, and vendors.
Transform data to define analytics solutions that support customer experience improvement initiatives.
Incorporate AI and machine learning solutions into analytics use cases where appropriate.
Analyze operational and non-operational data to identify trends, patterns, customer friction points, customer behavior, and improvement opportunities.
Apply statistical analysis, data mining techniques, and scenario modeling to validate assumptions and support decision-making.
Interpret data to identify solutions, communicate insights, and support business decisions.
Develop and maintain SQL models, ETL workflows, and analytics logic to support reporting and dashboard development.
Use Python to support analytics, data processing, modeling, and AI/ML development.
Effectively communicate technical findings, insights, and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders, subject matter experts, and cross-functional teams.
Support responsible data use, data quality, documentation, and governance practices.

5+ years of experience with data mining techniques, data modeling, statistical analysis, algorithms, or applied analytics.
5+ years of experience with data visualization using Power BI or similar data visualization tools.
5+ years of experience leveraging AWS services, including Redshift or similar cloud data platforms, to support scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions.
5+ years of experience using Python for analytics, SQL modeling, data processing, or AI/ML model development.
5+ years of experience using SQL and developing or maintaining ETL workflows, including SQL Server Integration Services or similar tools.
Experience working with large data sets and translating complex data into practical business insights.
Strong understanding of data modeling, dashboard development, analytics delivery, and reporting best practices.
Ability to facilitate requirements discussions, testing sessions, stakeholder reviews, and cross-functional solution development.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders.
Detail-oriented, results-driven, data-driven, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work a hybrid schedule in Newark, New Jersey, including three days per week in office.




Preferred Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, data science, or related analytics delivery.
Advanced degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.
Experience with customer analytics, customer experience, call center operations, or customer journey analysis.
Familiarity with data governance, data quality, and responsible AI practices.
AWS certification, Power BI certification, or related analytics certification.
Exposure to generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or other emerging technologies.
Experience developing analytics solutions for utility, energy, customer operations, or regulated business environments.
Experience working with business stakeholders, IT teams, vendor teams, and cross-functional analytics groups.




Why CARIAN

Purpose-driven work – Help deliver infrastructure that powers communities
Industry reputation – Trusted by leading utilities for our reliability and results
Career growth – Opportunities to lead major programs and mentor high-performing teams
Collaborative culture – Join a team that values delivery excellence and long-term relationships
